functions.name: get_terragrunt_dir
functions.description:
Gets the directory containing the Terragrunt configuration file.

* Returns the absolute path to the directory containing the Terragrunt configuration.
* Useful for constructing paths relative to the Terragrunt configuration file.

returnType.description: Absolute path to the Terragrunt configuration directory

functions.name: get_terraform_commands_that_need_vars
functions.description:
Gets the list of Terraform commands that accept input variables.

* Returns a list of Terraform commands that can use input variables.
* Useful for conditionally applying variable files.

returnType.description: List of Terraform commands that accept variables

functions.name: get_terraform_commands_that_need_locking
functions.description:
Gets the list of Terraform commands that use state locking.

* Returns a list of Terraform commands that use state locking.
* Useful for managing state lock behavior.

returnType.description: List of Terraform commands that use state locking

functions.name: run_cmd
functions.description:
Executes a shell command and returns its output.

* Runs the specified command and returns its stdout as a string.
* Useful for incorporating external script outputs into your configuration.

functions.name: sops_decrypt_file
functions.description:
Decrypts a file encrypted with SOPS.

* Decrypts the specified file using SOPS and returns its contents.
* Useful for managing encrypted configuration files.

functions.name: read_terragrunt_config
functions.description:
Reads and parses a Terragrunt configuration file.

* Reads the specified Terragrunt configuration file and returns its contents.
* Useful for sharing configuration between different Terragrunt files.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the Terragrunt configuration file

parameters.name: default_value
parameters.description: Default value to return if the file doesn't exist

functions.name: get_terraform_command
functions.description:
Gets the current Terraform command being executed.

* Returns the name of the Terraform command that Terragrunt is running.
* Useful for conditional logic based on the command being run.

functions.name: get_terraform_cli_args
functions.description:
Gets the command line arguments passed to Terraform.

* Returns the list of arguments that will be passed to Terraform.
* Useful for inspecting or modifying Terraform command arguments.

functions.name: get_env
functions.description:
Retrieves environment variables with an optional default value.

* Returns the value of the environment variable or the default value if not set.
* Useful for incorporating environment-specific values into your Terragrunt configurations.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the environment variable to retrieve

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: The default value to return if the environment variable is not set

returnType.description: Value of the environment variable or default value

functions.name: get_platform
functions.description:
Gets the current operating system platform.

* Returns the platform as Go's runtime.GOOS names it (e.g., 'windows', 'darwin', 'linux'), as Terragrunt does.
* Fails on SunOS, where Solaris and illumos have different Go names, and on Haiku, which Go does not support.
* Useful for platform-specific configurations.

functions.name: get_repo_root
functions.description:
Gets the root directory of the Git repository.

* Returns the absolute path to the root of the current Git repository.
* Useful for referencing files relative to the repository root.

returnType.description: Absolute path to Git repository root

functions.name: yamldecode
functions.description:
Decodes a YAML string into a value.

* Parses a YAML-formatted string and returns the resulting value.
* Useful for reading YAML configuration files.

functions.name: yamlencode
functions.description:
Encodes a value as a YAML string.

* Converts a value into a YAML-formatted string.
* Useful for generating YAML configuration files.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to encode as YAML

functions.name: jsondecode
functions.description:
Decodes a JSON string into a value.

* Parses a JSON-formatted string and returns the resulting value.
* Useful for reading JSON configuration files.

functions.name: jsonencode
functions.description:
Encodes a value as a JSON string.

* Converts a value into a JSON-formatted string.
* Useful for generating JSON configuration files.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to encode as JSON

functions.name: read_tfvars_file
functions.description:
Reads and parses a tfvars file.

* Reads the contents of a .tfvars file and returns the parsed variables.
* Useful for incorporating existing Terraform variable files.

functions.name: get_path_from_repo_root
functions.description:
Gets the path relative to the repository root.

* Returns the relative path from the repository root to the current configuration.
* Useful for generating paths based on repository structure.

functions.name: get_path_to_repo_root
functions.description:
Gets the path to the repository root.

* Returns the relative path from the current configuration to the repository root.
* Useful for referencing files at the repository root.

functions.name: basename
functions.description:
Gets the last element of a path.

* Returns the last element of a file path or URL.
* Useful for extracting filenames or final path components.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to extract the basename from

functions.name: dirname
functions.description:
Gets all but the last element of a path.

* Returns the directory path containing the specified path.
* Useful for getting parent directories.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to extract the directory from

functions.name: merge
functions.description:
Merges multiple maps into a single map.

* Combines multiple maps into a single map, with later values taking precedence.
* Useful for combining multiple configuration objects.

parameters.name: maps
parameters.description: Maps or objects to merge. A null adds nothing; with none, the result is an empty object

functions.name: coalesce
functions.description:
Returns the first non-null value from a list of values.

* Takes multiple arguments and returns the first non-null value.
* Useful for providing fallback values.

functions.name: find_in_parent_folders
functions.description: Searches upward from the current configuration and returns the absolute path to the nearest file with the explicit name. Throws when no file is found unless a fallback value is supplied.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Exact name of the file to find

parameters.name: fallback
parameters.description: Fallback value if the file is not found

returnType.description: Path to the found file/folder or fallback value

functions.name: path_relative_to_include
functions.description:
Returns the relative path between the current terragrunt.hcl file and the path specified in its include block.

* Returns the relative path from the including configuration to the current configuration.
* Useful for generating unique identifiers or paths based on directory structure.
* If multiple include blocks exist, requires a name parameter to specify which include block to base the relative path on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the include block to base the relative path on (required if multiple include blocks exist)

functions.name: get_parent_terragrunt_dir
functions.description:
Gets the directory containing the parent Terragrunt configuration file.

* Returns the absolute path to the directory containing the parent Terragrunt configuration.
* Useful for referencing files relative to the parent configuration.
* For configurations with multiple include blocks, requires a name parameter to specify which include block to use as the parent.
* Returns the root instead of the leaf of your terragrunt configurations.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the include block to base the parent directory on (required if multiple include blocks exist)

returnType.description: Absolute path to the parent Terragrunt configuration directory

functions.name: get_original_terragrunt_dir
functions.description:
Returns the directory where the original Terragrunt configuration file lives. This is primarily useful when one Terragrunt config is being read from another.

* Returns the absolute path to where the original terragrunt.hcl file lives.
* Useful when one Terragrunt config is being read from another config file.

returnType.description: Absolute path to original Terragrunt configuration directory

functions.name: get_terraform_commands_that_need_input
functions.description:
Gets the list of Terraform commands that accept the -input parameter.

* Returns a list of Terraform commands that accept the -input=(true or false) parameter.
* Useful for configuring commands that should run non-interactively.

returnType.description: List of Terraform commands that accept -input parameter

functions.name: get_terraform_commands_that_need_parallelism
functions.description:
Gets the list of Terraform commands that accept the -parallelism parameter.

* Returns a list of Terraform commands that can have their parallelism modified.
* Useful for controlling resource creation parallelism.

returnType.description: List of Terraform commands that accept -parallelism parameter

functions.name: get_aws_account_alias
functions.description:
Returns the AWS account alias associated with the current credentials.

* Returns the alias of the current AWS account.
* Returns empty string if alias cannot be found.
* Value can change during parsing of HCL code.

returnType.description: AWS account alias or empty string

functions.name: get_aws_account_id
functions.description:
Returns the AWS account ID associated with the current credentials.

* Returns the ID of the current AWS account.
* Value can change during parsing of HCL code, for example after evaluation of iam_role attribute.

functions.name: get_aws_caller_identity_arn
functions.description:
Returns the ARN of the AWS identity associated with the current credentials.

* Returns the ARN of the current AWS identity.
* Value can change during parsing of HCL code, for example after evaluation of iam_role attribute.

functions.name: get_aws_caller_identity_user_id
functions.description:
Returns the UserId of the AWS identity associated with the current credentials.

* Returns the UserId of the current AWS identity.
* Value can change during parsing of HCL code, for example after evaluation of iam_role attribute.

functions.name: get_working_dir
functions.description:
Returns the absolute path where Terragrunt runs Terraform commands.

* Returns the absolute path to the working directory.
* Useful when you need to manage substitutions of vars inside a *.tfvars file located in terragrunt's tmp dir.

functions.name: mark_as_read
functions.description:
Marks a file as read for inclusion by the queue-include-units-reading flag.

* Marks the specified file as being read by the configuration.
* Useful for situations when you want to mark a file as read but are not reading it using a native Terragrunt HCL function.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the file to mark as read

functions.name: get_default_retryable_errors
functions.description:
Returns the list of default retryable errors.

* Returns a list of error patterns that Terragrunt will retry by default.
* Useful for extending the default retry behavior.

returnType.description: List of default retryable error patterns

functions.name: get_terragrunt_source_cli_flag
functions.description:
Returns the value passed via --terragrunt-source flag or TERRAGRUNT_SOURCE environment variable.

* Returns the source override value if specified.
* Returns empty string if neither the flag nor environment variable is set.
* Useful for constructing hooks or flags that only apply to local development.

returnType.description: Source override value or empty string

functions.name: path_relative_from_include
functions.description:
Returns the relative path between the path specified in its include block and the current terragrunt.hcl file.

* Counterpart to path_relative_to_include().
* Useful for constructing relative paths from included configurations.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the include block to base the relative path on (required if multiple include blocks exist)

returnType.description: Relative path from include to current configuration

functions.name: abs
functions.description:
Returns the absolute value of a number.

* Returns the absolute value of the given number.
* If the number is 0 or positive, returns as-is.
* If the number is negative, returns its positive counterpart.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The number to get the absolute value of

returnType.description: Absolute value of the input number

functions.name: abspath
functions.description:
Converts a relative path to an absolute path.

* Takes a string containing a relative path and converts it to an absolute path.
* The path is relative to the current working directory.
* Does not verify that the resulting path exists.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative path to convert to absolute

functions.name: alltrue
functions.description:
Returns true if all elements in a list are true or "true".

* Takes a list of boolean values.
* Returns true if all elements are true.
* Returns false if any element is false.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: List of boolean values to check

returnType.description: True if all elements are true, false otherwise

functions.name: anytrue
functions.description:
Returns true if any element in a list is true or "true".

* Takes a list of boolean values.
* Returns true if any element is true.
* Returns false if all elements are false.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: List of boolean values to check

returnType.description: True if any element is true, false otherwise

functions.name: base64decode
functions.description:
Decodes a base64-encoded string.

* Takes a base64-encoded string and returns the decoded value.
* Returns an error if the input is not valid base64.

functions.name: base64encode
functions.description:
Encodes a string in base64.

* Takes a regular string and returns the base64-encoded value.

functions.name: base64gunzip
functions.description:
Decodes a base64-encoded string and un-gzips the result.

* Takes a base64-encoded gzipped string and returns the decoded, uncompressed value.
* Returns an error if the input is not valid base64 or gzip data.

functions.name: base64gzip
functions.description:
Compresses a string with gzip and base64-encodes the result.

* Takes a string, compresses it with gzip, and returns the base64-encoded result.

functions.name: base64gzip_compat
functions.description:
Compresses a string with gzip and base64-encodes the result exactly as `base64gzip` did in Terragrunt v1.1.3 and earlier.

* Produces the same bytes as the older `base64gzip`, for configurations that compare or store its output.
* Requires the `base64gzip-compat` experiment; without it every call fails.

functions.name: base64sha256
functions.description:
Returns a base64-encoded SHA256 hash of the given string.

* Computes the SHA256 hash of the input and returns it base64-encoded.

functions.name: base64sha512
functions.description:
Returns a base64-encoded SHA512 hash of the given string.

* Computes the SHA512 hash of the input and returns it base64-encoded.

functions.name: bcrypt
functions.description:
Returns a bcrypt hash of the given string.

* Generates a bcrypt hash of the input string.
* Cost parameter determines the computational complexity.

returnType.description: Bcrypt hash of the input string

functions.name: can
functions.description:
Tests whether an expression can be evaluated without error.

* Returns true if the expression can be evaluated.
* Returns false if evaluating the expression would produce an error.

returnType.description: True if expression can be evaluated, false otherwise

functions.name: ceil
functions.description:
Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the given number.

* Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.
* Returns the input unchanged if it's already an integer.

returnType.description: Smallest integer greater than or equal to the input

functions.name: chomp
functions.description:
Removes trailing newline characters from a string.

* Removes both Unix-style (LF) and Windows-style (CRLF) line endings.
* Returns the string unchanged if it has no trailing newlines.

functions.name: chunklist
functions.description:
Splits a list into fixed-size chunks.

* Splits a list into smaller lists of the specified size.
* The last chunk may be smaller if the list length is not divisible by the chunk size.

parameters.name: chunk_size
parameters.description: Size of each chunk, a whole number

functions.name: cidrcontains
functions.description:
Checks whether a given IP address belongs to a given CIDR network address range.

* Returns true if the IP address is within the specified CIDR range.
* Returns false otherwise.

returnType.description: True if IP is in CIDR range

functions.name: cidrhost
functions.description:
Calculates a full IP address within a CIDR range.

* Takes a CIDR prefix and host number.
* Returns the IP address that corresponds to that host number within the CIDR range.

parameters.name: hostnum
parameters.description: Host number within the CIDR range

returnType.description: IP address for the specified host

functions.name: cidrnetmask
functions.description:
Converts an IPv4 CIDR prefix length to its netmask address.

* Converts a CIDR prefix length (like /24) to a subnet mask address.
* Works only with IPv4 addresses.

functions.name: cidrsubnet
functions.description:
Calculates a subnet address within a larger CIDR range.

* Takes a CIDR prefix and extends its prefix length by a given number of bits.
* Returns a subnet address within the given CIDR range.

parameters.name: newbits
parameters.description: Number of additional bits for the subnet prefix

functions.name: cidrsubnets
functions.description:
Calculates multiple consecutive subnet addresses within a CIDR range.

* Takes a CIDR prefix and list of subnet sizes.
* Returns a list of consecutive subnet CIDR ranges.

parameters.name: newbits
parameters.description: List of numbers of new bits for each subnet

functions.name: compact
functions.description:
Removes null or empty string elements from a list.

* Takes a list and returns a new list with all null and "" elements removed.
* Preserves the order of the remaining elements.

returnType.description: List with null and empty string elements removed

functions.name: concat
functions.description:
Combines multiple lists into a single list.

* Takes two or more lists and combines them into a single list.
* Maintains the order of elements from the input lists.

functions.name: contains
functions.description:
Determines whether a list contains a given element.

* Returns true if the list contains the given value.
* Returns false otherwise.

returnType.description: True if value is in list

functions.name: csvdecode
functions.description:
Decodes CSV-formatted data into a list of maps.

* Takes a string containing CSV data.
* Returns a list of maps where each map's keys are from the header row.

returnType.description: List of maps representing CSV rows

functions.name: distinct
functions.description:
Removes duplicate elements from a list.

* Takes a list and returns a new list with duplicate elements removed.
* Preserves the order of first occurrence of each element.

functions.name: element
functions.description:
Retrieves a single element from a list by its index.

* Returns the element at the specified index.
* If index is greater than the list length, wraps around using modulo.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index to retrieve, a whole number

functions.name: endswith
functions.description:
Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

* Returns true if the string ends with the suffix.
* Returns false otherwise.

returnType.description: True if string ends with suffix

functions.name: file
functions.description:
Reads the contents of a file.

* Reads and returns the contents of the file at the given path.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to read

functions.name: filebase64
functions.description:
Reads and base64-encodes the contents of a file.

* Reads a file and returns its contents as a base64-encoded string.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to read

functions.name: filebase64sha256
functions.description:
Returns a base64-encoded SHA256 hash of a file's contents.

* Computes the SHA256 hash of the file's contents and returns it base64-encoded.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to hash

returnType.description: Base64-encoded SHA256 hash of the file

functions.name: filebase64sha512
functions.description:
Returns a base64-encoded SHA512 hash of a file's contents.

* Computes the SHA512 hash of the file's contents and returns it base64-encoded.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to hash

returnType.description: Base64-encoded SHA512 hash of the file

functions.name: fileexists
functions.description:
Determines whether a file exists at a given path.

* Returns true if a file exists at the specified path.
* Returns false if the file does not exist or is a directory.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to check for file existence

functions.name: filemd5
functions.description:
Returns the MD5 hash of a file's contents.

* Computes and returns the MD5 hash of the file's contents.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to hash

functions.name: fileset
functions.description:
Enumerates the files below a directory that match a glob pattern.

* Returns the regular files whose path relative to the directory matches the pattern, relative to the directory and in lexical order; directories that symbolic links in it resolve to are searched too.
* The pattern uses doublestar syntax: `*` and `?` within one path segment, `**` as a whole segment for any number of directories, `[...]` classes, `{a,b}` alternatives and `\` escapes.
* A relative directory resolves from the configuration file's directory, an empty one is that directory itself, and no boundary applies.
* Each file it answers counts as read by the unit where Terragrunt's discovery evaluates the call, such as in locals, but not in inputs or generate.
* A sensitive directory or pattern makes the answer sensitive, and a refusal shows `(sensitive value)` in its place.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Doublestar pattern matched against each file's path relative to the directory

functions.name: filesha1
functions.description:
Returns the SHA1 hash of a file's contents.

* Computes and returns the SHA1 hash of the file's contents.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to hash

functions.name: filesha256
functions.description:
Returns the SHA256 hash of a file's contents.

* Computes and returns the SHA256 hash of the file's contents.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to hash

functions.name: filesha512
functions.description:
Returns the SHA512 hash of a file's contents.

* Computes and returns the SHA512 hash of the file's contents.
* Path is relative to the configuration file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to hash

functions.name: flatten
functions.description:
Flattens nested lists into a single list.

* Takes a list that may contain other lists and flattens it into a single list.
* Removes all nesting levels.
* Preserves the order of elements.

functions.name: floor
functions.description:
Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the given number.

* Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.
* Returns the input unchanged if it's already an integer.

returnType.description: Largest integer less than or equal to the input

functions.name: format
functions.description:
Creates a string by formatting a number of values according to a format string.

* Similar to sprintf in other languages.
* Supports various format verbs (%s, %d, %g, etc.).

functions.name: formatdate
functions.description:
Converts a timestamp into a different time format.

* Formats a timestamp string into the specified format.
* Uses strftime-style format specifiers.

functions.name: formatlist
functions.description:
Creates a list of strings by formatting each of several collections of values.

* Like format, but applies the format string to each element of a list.
* Returns a list of formatted strings.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Values to format. A list gives one of its elements to each string, and every list must be as long as the others; any other value is used in every string

functions.name: indent
functions.description:
Adds a prefix to all but the first line of a multi-line string.

* Adds the specified number of spaces to the beginning of all lines except the first.
* Useful for formatting multi-line strings.

functions.name: index
functions.description:
Finds the index of a given value in a list.

* Returns the index of the first occurrence of a value in a list.
* Returns an error if the value is not found.

returnType.description: Index of the value in the list

functions.name: log
functions.description:
Returns the logarithm of a number in a given base.

* Calculates the logarithm of a number using the specified base.
* Returns an error if either argument is <= 0.

functions.name: lookup
functions.description:
Retrieves the value of a given key from a map.

* Looks up the value for a given key in a map.
* Can provide a default value if the key doesn't exist.
* Returns an error if key not found and no default provided.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: Map to look up value in

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Default value if key not found

functions.name: lower
functions.description:
Converts all characters in a string to lowercase.

* Converts string to lowercase.
* Returns an empty string if given an empty string.

functions.name: matchkeys
functions.description:
Returns a list of values from the first list whose corresponding values in the second list match a given value.

* Takes two lists of equal length and a search value.
* Returns elements from first list where corresponding elements in second list match search value.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: List of values to select from

functions.name: max
functions.description:
Returns the largest value from a list of numbers.

* Takes one or more numbers and returns the highest value.
* Returns an error if any argument is not a number.

functions.name: min
functions.description:
Returns the smallest value from a list of numbers.

* Takes one or more numbers and returns the lowest value.
* Returns an error if any argument is not a number.

functions.name: one
functions.description:
Returns either the first non-null value or the last value from a list.

* Takes list of values and returns first non-null value.
* If all values are null, returns the last value.
* If list is empty, returns null.

returnType.description: First non-null value or last value

functions.name: parseint
functions.description:
Parses a string as a number in the specified base.

* Converts a string representation of an integer to a number.
* Supports bases 2 through 62.

functions.name: pow
functions.description:
Returns the given number raised to the given power.

* Raises base number to specified exponent.
* Returns an error if result would be imaginary.

functions.name: range
functions.description:
Generates a list of numbers from a start up to, but not including, a limit.

* `range(limit)` counts from 0, `range(start, limit)` from start, both by 1 or by -1 when the limit is below the start.
* `range(start, limit, step)` counts by step, which must move towards the limit.
* Generates at most 1024 numbers.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First number in the range; when it is the only argument, the limit, and the range starts at 0

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Increment between numbers: 1, or -1 when the limit is below the start, unless given

returnType.description: List of numbers in the range

functions.name: regex
functions.description:
Applies a regular expression to a string and returns the first match.

* Returns the first match found in the string.
* Returns an error if the pattern is invalid.

functions.name: regexall
functions.description:
Applies a regular expression to a string and returns all matches.

* Returns a list of all non-overlapping matches in the string.
* Returns an error if the pattern is invalid.

functions.name: replace
functions.description:
Replaces all occurrences of a substring in a string.

* Replaces each occurrence of search string with replace string.
* Case-sensitive replacement.

functions.name: reverse
functions.description:
Reverses a list of elements.

* Creates a new list with all elements in reverse order.
* Works with lists of any element type.

functions.name: rsadecrypt
functions.description:
Decrypts an RSA-encrypted message.

* Decrypts ciphertext using provided private key.
* Expects base64-encoded ciphertext.

parameters.name: privatekey
parameters.description: RSA private key in PEM format

validation.pattern: ^-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----$

functions.name: setintersection
functions.description:
Takes multiple sets and returns a new set containing only elements that appear in all of the given sets.

* Returns the intersection of all given sets.
* Returns empty list if no common elements exist.
* Sets are represented as lists.

returnType.description: Set of elements common to all input sets

functions.name: setproduct
functions.description:
Takes multiple sets and returns a new set containing all possible combinations of elements from each set.

* Returns the Cartesian product of the given sets.
* Sets are represented as lists.

parameters.name: sets
parameters.description: Further sets to combine, at least one

functions.name: setsubtract
functions.description:
Takes two sets and returns a new set containing elements from the first set that are not present in the second set.

* Returns elements unique to the first set.
* Sets are represented as lists.

returnType.description: Set of elements in first set but not in second

functions.name: setunion
functions.description:
Takes multiple sets and returns a new set containing all unique elements from all sets.

* Returns the union of all given sets.
* Removes duplicate elements.
* Sets are represented as lists.

functions.name: slice
functions.description:
Extracts a portion of a list between two indices.

* Returns a subset of a list from start index up to but not including end index.
* Indices can be negative to count from end of list.

functions.name: sort
functions.description:
Sorts a list of strings lexicographically.

* Returns a new list with all elements sorted.
* Only works with lists of strings.
* Case-sensitive sorting.

functions.name: split
functions.description:
Splits a string by a given separator.

* Returns a list of substrings.
* If separator is empty, splits into individual characters.
* If no separator found, returns single-element list.

functions.name: strcontains
functions.description:
Checks if a string contains a given substring.

* Returns true if the string contains the given substring.
* Case-sensitive comparison.

functions.name: strrev
functions.description:
Reverses a string.

* Returns a new string with characters in reverse order.
* Works with Unicode strings.

functions.name: substr
functions.description:
Extracts a substring from a string.

* Returns part of a string based on offset and length.
* A negative length returns the rest of the string from offset.
* Offset can be negative to count from end of string.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Length of substring to extract; a negative length takes the rest of the string

functions.name: tobool
functions.description:
Converts a value to boolean.

* Converts its argument to a boolean value.
* Accepts various string representations like "true", "false", "1", "0".
* Returns error if conversion not possible.

functions.name: tolist
functions.description:
Converts a value to list.

* Converts its argument to a list.
* If given a list, returns it unchanged.
* Can convert sets and tuples to lists.

functions.name: tomap
functions.description:
Converts a value to map.

* Converts its argument to a map.
* If given a map, returns it unchanged.
* Returns error if conversion not possible.

functions.name: tonumber
functions.description:
Converts a value to number.

* Converts its argument to a number.
* Can convert string representations of numbers.
* Returns error if conversion not possible.

functions.name: toset
functions.description:
Converts a value to set.

* Converts its argument to a set.
* Removes duplicate elements.
* Most commonly used with lists.

functions.name: tostring
functions.description:
Converts a value to string.

* Converts its argument to a string.
* Works with numbers, bools, and other primitive types.
* Returns error if conversion not possible.

functions.name: textdecodebase64
functions.description:
Decodes a Base64-encoded string into text in the given character encoding.

* Decodes the bytes as UTF-8 or UTF-16.
* Returns error if input is not valid base64 or the encoding is not supported.
* Useful for decoding stored credentials or certificates.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Character encoding of the decoded bytes: UTF-8 or UTF-16

functions.name: textencodebase64
functions.description:
Encodes text in the given character encoding as a Base64 string.

* Encodes the text as UTF-8 or UTF-16 bytes, then as base64.
* Useful for storing text in formats that require base64.
* Returns error if the encoding is not supported.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Character encoding of the encoded bytes: UTF-8 or UTF-16

functions.name: timeadd
functions.description:
Adds a duration to a timestamp.

* Adds specified duration to timestamp.
* Supports various duration units (s, m, h).
* Returns RFC 3339 formatted timestamp.

functions.name: timecmp
functions.description:
Compares two timestamps.

* Returns -1 if first timestamp is earlier.
* Returns 0 if timestamps are equal.
* Returns 1 if first timestamp is later.

functions.name: timestamp
functions.description:
Returns the current timestamp.

* Returns current time in RFC 3339 format.
* Time is in UTC.
* Precision is to seconds.

functions.name: trim
functions.description:
Removes specified characters from start and end of string.

* Removes all instances of specified characters from both ends.
* Case-sensitive matching.

parameters.name: chars
parameters.description: Characters to trim, each taken separately

functions.name: trimprefix
functions.description:
Removes specified prefix from start of string.

* Removes prefix if string starts with it.
* Returns string unchanged if it doesn't start with prefix.
* Case-sensitive matching.

functions.name: trimspace
functions.description:
Removes all leading and trailing whitespace.

* Removes spaces, tabs, newlines from both ends.
* Similar to trim() but specifically for whitespace.
* Doesn't affect whitespace inside string.

returnType.description: String with whitespace removed from ends

functions.name: trimsuffix
functions.description:
Removes specified suffix from end of string.

* Removes suffix if string ends with it.
* Returns string unchanged if it doesn't end with suffix.
* Case-sensitive matching.

functions.name: transpose
functions.description:
Takes a map of lists of strings and swaps the keys and values.

* Creates new map with keys from list values and values from list of keys.
* All lists must have same length.
* Values must be strings.

functions.name: try
functions.description:
Evaluates each expression in turn and returns the first that succeeds.

* Returns the expression's value if evaluation succeeds.
* Otherwise tries each fallback in order, and fails if none succeeds.
* Useful for handling potential errors gracefully.

parameters.name: fallbacks
parameters.description: Expressions to try in order if evaluation fails

returnType.description: Result of the first expression that succeeds

functions.name: upper
functions.description:
Converts all characters in a string to uppercase.

* Converts string to uppercase.
* Works with Unicode characters.
* Returns empty string if given empty string.

functions.name: urlencode
functions.description:
Encodes a string according to URL encoding rules.

* URL-encodes the given string.
* Replaces special characters with percent-encoded values.
* Safe for use in URLs.

functions.name: urldecode
functions.description:
Decodes a URL-encoded string.

* Decodes a URL-encoded string.
* Converts percent-encoded sequences to original characters.
* Returns error if input is not valid URL-encoded string.

functions.name: uuid
functions.description:
Generates a random UUID.

* Generates a random UUID v4.
* Returns a new UUID each time it's called.
* Useful for creating unique identifiers.

functions.name: uuidv5
functions.description:
Generates a UUID v5 from a namespace UUID and name.

* Generates deterministic UUID based on namespace and name.
* Uses SHA-1 hashing.
* Returns same UUID for same inputs.

functions.name: values
functions.description:
Returns a list of the values in a map.

* Extracts all values from a map into a list.
* Order of values is not guaranteed.
* Useful for iterating over map values.

functions.name: zipmap
functions.description:
Creates a map from a list of keys and a list of values.

* Combines two lists into a map.
* First list provides keys, second list provides values.
* Lists must be same length.

returnType.description: Map combining the keys and values

functions.name: pathexpand
functions.description:
Expands a path containing a ~ prefix into a full path.

* Replaces ~ with user's home directory path.
* Works with both Unix and Windows paths.
* Returns the path unchanged if it doesn't start with ~.

functions.name: startswith
functions.description:
Checks if a string starts with a specified prefix.

* Returns true if the string starts with the prefix.
* Case-sensitive comparison.
* Returns false if either argument is empty.

returnType.description: True if string starts with prefix

functions.name: sensitive
functions.description:
Marks a value as sensitive, preventing it from appearing in logs and output.

* Wraps the given value and marks it as sensitive.
* The value can still be used normally in expressions.
* Terraform/OpenTofu will hide this value in logs and terminal output.

functions.name: nonsensitive
functions.description:
Removes the sensitive marking from a value.

* Unwraps a sensitive value, removing the sensitive marking.
* Use with caution as it makes sensitive values visible.
* Returns the value unchanged if it wasn't marked sensitive.

functions.name: issensitive
functions.description:
Checks whether a value is marked as sensitive.

* Returns true if the value is marked as sensitive.
* Returns false for regular values.
* Useful for conditional logic based on value sensitivity.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to check for sensitive marking

functions.name: ephemeralasnull
functions.description:
Returns a value with each ephemeral part replaced by null.

* Terragrunt has no ephemeral values, so the value is returned unchanged, sensitive or not.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value whose ephemeral parts become null

returnType.description: The value, with no ephemeral part

functions.name: assumeequal
functions.description:
Asserts that a value equals the value assumed for it, and returns the assumed value.

* Converts the actual value to the assumed value's type first, and fails when it cannot or when the two differ.
* The result is the assumed value: whether the actual value was sensitive does not carry over.

parameters.name: actual_value
parameters.description: Value to make the assumption about

parameters.name: expected_value
parameters.description: Value the first argument is assumed to equal

functions.name: assumenotnull
functions.description:
Asserts that a value is not null, and returns it.

* Fails on a null value. The `null` keyword has no type, so it fails for that reason: give it one by converting it first.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value assumed not to be null

functions.name: assumestringprefix
functions.description:
Asserts that a string begins with a prefix, and returns the string.

* Compares with the prefix less its last character, unless that character is a delimiter such as `/`, `:` or `-`, because a later character could combine with it.
* A string shorter than the prefix passes when it begins the prefix, and a null string passes.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: String to make the assumption about

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Prefix the string is assumed to have

functions.name: assumelistlength
functions.description:
Asserts that a list's length lies between two bounds, inclusive, and returns the list.

* Converts the value to a list first, so its elements take one type.
* The bounds must be whole numbers. A negative minimum is no bound; a negative maximum is never met.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: List to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumelistlengthmin
functions.description:
Asserts that a list has at least a given number of elements, and returns the list.

* Converts the value to a list first, so its elements take one type.
* The bound must be a whole number. A negative one is no bound.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: List to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumelistlengthmax
functions.description:
Asserts that a list has at most a given number of elements, and returns the list.

* Converts the value to a list first, so its elements take one type.
* The bound must be a whole number. A negative one is never met.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: List to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumesetlength
functions.description:
Asserts that a set's length lies between two bounds, inclusive, and returns the set.

* Converts the value to a set first, so an element written twice counts once.
* The bounds must be whole numbers. A negative minimum is no bound; a negative maximum is never met.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Set to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumesetlengthmin
functions.description:
Asserts that a set has at least a given number of elements, and returns the set.

* Converts the value to a set first, so an element written twice counts once.
* The bound must be a whole number. A negative one is no bound.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Set to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumesetlengthmax
functions.description:
Asserts that a set has at most a given number of elements, and returns the set.

* Converts the value to a set first, so an element written twice counts once.
* The bound must be a whole number. A negative one is never met.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Set to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumemaplength
functions.description:
Asserts that a map's number of elements lies between two bounds, inclusive, and returns the map.

* Converts the value to a map first, so its values take one type.
* The bounds must be whole numbers. A negative minimum is no bound; a negative maximum is never met.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Map to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumemaplengthmin
functions.description:
Asserts that a map has at least a given number of elements, and returns the map.

* Converts the value to a map first, so its values take one type.
* The bound must be a whole number. A negative one is no bound.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Map to make the assumption about

functions.name: assumemaplengthmax
functions.description:
Asserts that a map has at most a given number of elements, and returns the map.

* Converts the value to a map first, so its values take one type.
* The bound must be a whole number. A negative one is never met.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Map to make the assumption about

functions.name: list
functions.description:
Removed in Terraform v0.12: every call fails.

* Write a list with `tolist([ ... ])` instead.
functions.deprecationMessage: The list function is not available in OpenTofu; use tolist([ ... ]) syntax to write a literal list.

functions.name: map
functions.description:
Removed in Terraform v0.12: every call fails.

* Write a map with `tomap({ ... })` instead.

parameters.name: vals
parameters.description: Alternating keys and values of the map

functions.deprecationMessage: The map function is not available in OpenTofu; use tomap({ ... }) syntax to write a literal map.

functions.name: templatefile
functions.description:
Reads the contents of a template file and renders it with the given variables.

* Reads and interpolates a template file.
* Supports ${...} syntax for variable interpolation.
* Variables are provided as a map of values.

parameters.name: vars
parameters.description: Map of variables to use in template

functions.name: templatestring
functions.description:
Renders a template string with the given variables.

* Like templatefile but works with an inline template string.
* Supports ${...} syntax for variable interpolation.
* Variables are provided as a map of values.

parameters.name: vars
parameters.description: Map of variables to use in template

functions.name: coalescelist
functions.description: Returns the first non-empty list from its arguments.

functions.name: join
functions.description: Joins the strings of one or more lists using a separator.

functions.name: keys
functions.description: Returns the keys of a map in lexicographical order.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Returns the number of elements in a collection or characters in a string.

functions.name: md5
functions.description: Computes the MD5 hash of a string and returns its hexadecimal digest.

functions.name: sha1
functions.description: Computes the SHA-1 hash of a string and returns its hexadecimal digest.

functions.name: sha256
functions.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of a string and returns its hexadecimal digest.

functions.name: sha512
functions.description: Computes the SHA-512 hash of a string and returns its hexadecimal digest.

functions.name: signum
functions.description: Returns -1, 0, or 1 to indicate the sign of a number.

functions.name: sum
functions.description: Returns the sum of the numbers in a list.

functions.name: title
functions.description: Converts the first letter of each word in a string to uppercase.

functions.name: deep_merge
functions.description: Recursively merges maps and objects, with later arguments taking precedence.

functions.name: mark_glob_as_read
functions.description: Expands a gobwas-compatible glob and marks every matching file as read. Relative patterns resolve from the current working directory. Expansion is confined to the enclosing Git repository unless a leading --terragrunt-boundary argument explicitly changes the boundary, given inline ("--terragrunt-boundary=<directory>", pattern) or as the next argument ("--terragrunt-boundary", directory, pattern); a relative boundary resolves from the current working directory. The walk starts at the pattern's longest leading directory before its first `*`, `?`, `[`, `{` or `\`, or at the path itself when it has none, and is refused when that directory is not within the boundary, symbolic links resolved. Matches come in the order the walk meets them.

parameters.name: boundary_or_pattern
parameters.description: The pattern, or the boundary: --terragrunt-boundary=<directory>, or --terragrunt-boundary followed by the directory

parameters.name: directory_or_pattern
parameters.description: The pattern after --terragrunt-boundary=<directory>, or the boundary directory after --terragrunt-boundary

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: The pattern after --terragrunt-boundary and its directory

returnType.description: Absolute paths matched by the glob.

functions.name: constraint_check
functions.description: Checks whether a version satisfies a version constraint.

returnType.description: True when the version satisfies the constraint.
